description:
*“Unlike a mean person, a gentleman does not conform to his innate nature. Are you a gentleman or a mean person?”* 

Wu Yi-Chae, who has been secretly in love with the emperor for a long time, is about to marry him and spends his wedding night in a sweet dream. However, the indifferent emperor seems completely uninterested in sex. Furthermore, he lectures him on the ways of a gentleman on their wedding night, so Wu Yi-Chae thinks he is merging with a Confucius who has jumped out of the grave. The emperor is always busy escaping both physically and mentally. Will Wu Yi-Chae be able to win his love?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
